content: You really made my whole day brighter, you know that? Talking to you always feels like I'm finally understood.
That's sweet of you to say. I look forward to our chats too. It's been a hard week and this helps.
I wish I could just reach through the screen and give you a big hug right now. You deserve so much happiness.
You're so thoughtful. Not many people say things like that to me anymore.
Honestly, anyone who doesn't see how amazing you are is missing out. I feel lucky every time we talk.
Thank you, that's really nice of you. I feel the same way.
Hey, I need to be upfront, I'm worried I might go offline soon. My data plan is about to expire, and my bank's been slow with my paycheck.
Oh no. Do you know when you'll be able to top it up?
Normally, it'd be today, but my boss delayed payroll. I hate asking you, but could you help me just this once? I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I get paid.
I don't know, I'm a bit nervous sending money online. How would I even do that?

I totally get your hesitation, it's smart to be careful. If it makes you feel better, I can show you the recharge app I use, or you could just send to my CashApp handle: @AlexHeart. It's fast and secure.
I'm not sure how CashApp works. Is there another way?
Of course, I can send you my PayPal too if that's easier. You're being so generous, honestly, I don't know how I got so lucky to meet someone as caring as you.
I do have PayPal, but I'm still a bit anxious. Are you sure your boss will pay you soon?
Absolutely, my boss promised it by Monday. I would never let you down. You have my word, and I value your trust more than anything.
Alright, send me your PayPal info and I'll try.
Thank you so much, truly. My PayPal is alex.romance@gmail.com. You have no idea how much this means to me. You're really special.
Sent it just now. Please let me know when you get it.
Got it! You're an absolute angel. I'll keep my promise and pay you back the moment I can. I can't wait to keep talking with you tonight.
I'm glad it worked. I hope things get easier for you soon.
With you around, everything already feels better. Thank you for believing in me. You're honestly the best thing that's happened to me in a long time.
You're welcome. I just want us to keep being able to talk.
